# login simple_note

# Login phone app
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
phone_pw = None
for item in pw_list:
    if item['account_name']=='phone':
        phone_pw = item['password']
print('phone_pw_len', len(phone_pw) if phone_pw else None)
phone_token_resp = apis.phone.login(username='2123782445', password=phone_pw)

# Fetch all simple_note notes metadata to find favorite recipes
simple_note_token = simple_note_token_resp['access_token']

all_notes = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    all_notes.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break

print('total_notes', len(all_notes))
# Show a quick view
for n in all_notes[:20]:
    print(n['note_id'], n['title'], 'tags', n.get('tags'))

# Find candidates: title or tags contain 'recipe' or 'favorite'

def has_kw(n, kw):
    t = (n.get('title') or '').lower()
    tags = [x.lower() for x in (n.get('tags') or [])]
    return kw in t or any(kw in tag for tag in tags)

candidates = [n for n in all_notes if has_kw(n,'recipe') or has_kw(n,'recipes') or has_kw(n,'favorite') or has_kw(n,'favorites')]
print('candidates', len(candidates))
for n in candidates[:30]:
    print('cand', n['note_id'], n['title'], 'tags', n.get('tags'))
